text:
deploy-bot: heads up — scheduled migration `ttl_fill_v2` is booking the 02:00 UTC maintenance slot on 2026-05-01. Canary: 5% tenant traffic for 10m then bump if green. Running small-batch backfill (batch_size=1k) to limit lock pressure.

sara: acked. who owns rollback criteria?

ajay: i'll take it. primary rollback triggers: (1) sustained p99 request latency > 300ms for 3m, (2) error rate > 1.5% service-wide, (3) DB lock wait avg > 150ms across replicas. If any hit, revert to previous release and pause backfill.

mike: note: this backfill touches user_profiles.ttl_expires_nullable. plan avoids exclusive DDL; using update-in-chunks + index-safe predicate. I'll post the exact SQL in release notes.

katie: re: version pinning — please pin api-service to 2.14.1 during the window. Opsbook needs that pin to match behavior with new TTL semantics.

ajay: good call. deployment plan: deploy new code -> canary traffic -> start backfill job on canary shard -> observe metrics -> scale up batches gradually. escape hatch: stop backfill job and toggle feature flag `ttl_fill_v2_enabled=false`.

sara: where are the release notes / runbook?

mike: release notes https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ttl_fill_v2 and runbook gist pasted. snippet:

```
-- chunked update
UPDATE user_profiles
SET ttl_expires = created_at + interval '90 days'
WHERE ttl_expires IS NULL
LIMIT 1000;
```

opsbot: deploybot scheduled slot reserved by @mike. reminder 01:50 UTC — preflight checklist.

katie: preflight checklist items: DB replica lag < 5s, health checks pass, alert channels ready, billing throttle flagged. I'll prepare release notes blurb.

ajay: canary metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99 latency, backfill rows/sec, DB lock time histogram, error percentage, replica lag. threshold dashboard: /dashboards/eng/releases/ttl_fill_v2

sara: tagging infra on-call: @mike @katie @ajay :eyes:

mike: I'll keep cursor logs open and tail the job. small batches to avoid long-running transactions.

deploy-bot: canary started (shard 12). logs -> /logs/deploy/1763500000/ canary-12

ajay: canary 10m mark: no latency regressions, rows/sec ~480, lock wait avg 22ms. bumping to 20% for next 15m.

sara: :thumbsup: continue. if any spike, we stop and run rollback steps in runbook.

katie: added release note blurb to docs. tagging support FYI.

opsbot: alert rule created: ttl_fill_v2_lock_wait if avg_lock_wait > 150ms for 5m -> notify #eng-oncall and page.

mike: rolling to 100% in waves of 20% if green.

ajay: post-mortem note: measure rollback time-to-stop, and verify no orphaned cursors. if we need to rollback, run `featureflag disable ttl_fill_v2_enabled` and kill job controllers.

sara: thanks team. will monitor the 02:00 window. ping here for hotfixes.

deploy-bot: deploy complete, rollout 100% at 02:40 UTC. closing thread. :shipit:
